lead_raw_text:
The structure of Hg4S4Se4 (reduced formula HgSSe) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Hg centers with two S and two Se neighbors (2.65–2.77 Å), while S and Se centers each have two Hg neighbors at 2.65–2.77 Å; these environments are all three-dimensional. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in one component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner-sharing between 8-vertex S and Se coordination polyhedra and between 8-vertex Hg polyhedra.
